item.name: 10. Redis Cache & Rate Limiting
item.description:
Verifies Redis caching for redirects and cache invalidation on mutation.

Cache hit vs miss is not distinguishable from HTTP status alone — both return 302. Use redis-cli on the VM to confirm the cache entry after the first redirect:
  redis-cli -a <password> GET url:<shortCode>

RATE LIMIT: The automated rate-limit path (429) is intentionally NOT included here because each full collection run increments the Redis counter — including Folder 9's /trial-key hit — and the counter persists for 24 hours. Including more hits would break every subsequent run. To test the 429 path manually:
  1. First reset the counter: redis-cli -h <host> -p 6379 -a <password> DEL trial_key_count:::1
  2. Call POST /trial-key four times in quick succession — the 4th returns 429.
  3. Clean up the extra trial subscribers: DELETE FROM subscribers WHERE api_key LIKE 'sk_%';
  4. Reset the counter again before the next collection run.

item.name: 11. Moderation & Admin Safety
item.description:
Tests for the URL safety pipeline (Google Safe Browsing, malicious_urls, flagged_domains) and admin moderation controls.

PREREQUISITES:

1. Run `npm run cleanup` from the backend directory before starting this folder. It handles all seeding automatically:
   - Seeds 3 malicious_urls rows for testsafebrowsing.appspot.com (so escalation fires on item 5)
   - Seeds the blocked-test URL for the redirect test in item 9

2. Set the 'adminSecret' collection variable to match ADMIN_SECRET in your .env (one-time setup).

3. GOOGLE_SAFE_BROWSING_API_KEY must be set in .env — items 1 and 5 make real GSB API calls.

HOW THE ESCALATION SEQUENCE WORKS:
  cleanup seeds 3 rows -> item 1 (malware.html) hits GSB -> 4th row inserted (no escalation yet)
  -> item 5 (phishing.html) hits GSB -> 5th row inserted -> escalation fires -> pending_review
  -> items 6-9 (admin controls) operate on the now-flagged domain

Fail-open sanity check (manual only): Remove GOOGLE_SAFE_BROWSING_API_KEY from .env and POST a brand-new URL not in malicious_urls or flagged_domains — it should return 201, never 403.

CLEANUP SQL before re-running this folder:
  DELETE FROM malicious_urls WHERE domain = 'testsafebrowsing.appspot.com';
  DELETE FROM flagged_domains WHERE domain = 'testsafebrowsing.appspot.com';
  DELETE FROM urls WHERE short_code = 'blocked-test';
  -- Then re-seed blocked-test using the SQL in prerequisite 2 above.
